Chandra Mohan Pandey vs State Of Uttarakhand on 13 June,
2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani

 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 526 of 2024
Chandra Mohan Pandey ........Applicant
 Versus

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Present:-

Mr. A.M. Saklani and Mr. M.C. Upadhyay, Advocates for the
 applicant.
Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, Aga for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

The applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Fir No.23 of 2023 dated 25.11.2023, under Sections 420,
467, 468, 471, 120-B Ipc, Police Station Thatyur, District Tehri Garhwal.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
Instant FIR has been lodged on an application filed under Section 156(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
4. According to the FIR, the informant had certain land recorded in their name.
One of the co-accused Rajan Singh with the collusion of the co-accused was involved in the sale and purchase of those lands.
The applicant is a Revenue Sub Inspector.
There are allegations that with the collusions of the Revenue Officers the applicant committed manipulation in the records.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that there is no specific role assigned to the applicant.
He would submit that, now the entries have already been corrected.
6. State to file objections within four weeks.

Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond and two Chandra Mohan Pandey vs State Of Uttarakhand on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9550460/
1 reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-

entities.text: Chandra Mohan Pandey vs State Of Uttarakhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witness in the case.
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) He shall deposit his passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, if the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 13.06.2024
